author: AsmFoundation
name: Assembly + .NET Solution
description: A solution with a C# console app, the assembly library it calls through the C# bindings the SDK writes from the library's PROTO lines (NASM for x64, GNU syntax for ARM64), and xUnit.net v3 tests of that library. Built by AsmFoundation.Sdk and the .NET SDK for Windows, Linux and macOS.

SdkVersion.description: The AsmFoundation.Sdk version the assembly project names in its Sdk attribute. Default: the version of this template package, which is released with the SDK of the same version.

TestRunner.displayName: Test runner for 'dotnet test' and Test Explorer
TestRunner.description: Test runner for 'dotnet test' and Test Explorer, as in xUnit.net's own xunit3 template. mtp-v2 also sets Microsoft.Testing.Platform as the runner in global.json (created when there is none), which 'dotnet test' needs from the .NET 10 SDK on.

skipRestore.description: If specified, skips the automatic restore of the solution on create.

postActions.description: Restore NuGet packages required by this solution.
Create or update 'global.json' file required by Microsoft.Testing.Platform.

manualInstructions.text: If using .NET 10 SDK or later, add "test": { "runner": "Microsoft.Testing.Platform" } to global.json, creating it at the repository root when there is none: https://xunit.net/docs/getting-started/v3/microsoft-testing-platform#using-net-sdk-version-10-or-later
